landing.heroSubtitle: Create playlists, upload your tracks and stream them anywhere — in a player as minimal as it feels.
landing.featuresSubtitle: From your first playlist to a shared link — thoughtful and simple.
landing.ctaSectionSubtitle: Create an account in seconds and upload your first track.

playlists.title: Playlists as folders
playlists.desc: Organize your music into clear collections — quick to create, renamable any time.

upload.title: Direct upload
upload.desc: Upload tracks up to 500 MB with real progress. MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC and more.

streaming.title: Streaming with waveform
streaming.desc: A modern player with waveform, shuffle, loop and a full-screen view at the tap of a button.

metadata.title: Edit metadata
metadata.desc: Title, artist, description and cover — all customizable.

sharing.title: Share publicly
sharing.desc: Create a link and share individual tracks with anyone, no login required.

minimal.title: Modern & minimal
minimal.desc: A clean, dark interface focused on what matters: your music.

library.subtitle: All your playlists in one place.
